spec: ISA 0.9 §10.1 K12 launch params_hash; §12.3 K13 argument encoding and K91 token identity
derivation: params_hash covers the JCS args array only. Two token arguments with the same tuple have identical args bytes for the all-alias and all-distinct partitions; the primary token is occurrence zero. K91 binds the partition separately, so the two complete invocations differ. The resolved outer budget is not part of params_hash. This is an identity witness, not a launch-estimator implementation verdict.

expected_outcome.resource_decimal: exact rational then upward 34 significant digits
